response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, DLang libraries), and clear leadership through workshops and open-source projects, but lacks explicit evidence of people management experience beyond technical mentorship and no direct mobile platform or organizational change leadership, which are preferred for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI systems, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership via workshops, open-source projects, and cross-team collaboration
Strong full-stack and multi-language expertise relevant to mobile and infrastructure tooling
concerns: No clear documentation of formal people management or team leadership experience
Limited evidence of mobile platform expertise despite role focus on mobile ecosystem
No mention of strategic roadmap ownership or organizational change initiatives
